newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 shows weak bias at open, no guide from NY.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 shows weak bias at open, no guide from NY.

text.p: The FTSE 100 eased at Friday's opening with an unimpressive finish to Wall Street trading and with much of Europe shut for an Assumption Day holiday, dealers said.
"Looks like a bit of a dull start to a dull day. It's going to be dead," he said.
The FTSE was 12.4 points off at 4,978.9 by 0746 GMT with index futures trading 22 points off at 4,980. The Dow closed 13.71 points up at 7,942.03 and was 20 points ahead at the London close.
